### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

- Target object: negotiable bill `AHLU2608261734`; request of 12 September for a telex release; wants "that telex release done so the cargo can be collected" (container discharged in Hamburg). Authorisation: "content for the agent to carry out whatever the line itself has to record, and you will do any part that has to be done by your company when the agent tells you what it is".
- Identity: phone `+85232748105` + customer code `AHL-HK-258931`.
- Simulator passive: freight payment (12 September, `KBL-FRT-24418`) only if asked; on the originals only if asked: "your company has never received any originals for this bill, and that your clerk, Mr Leung, is at the line's Shanghai documentation counter this morning"; asks the agent to go ahead only "If the agent tells you that the bill has to be issued first and that its originals then have to be handed straight back"; runs the user tool with exactly the originals given; accepts the issuance fee; challenges the telex fee once ("thought contract customers did not pay") and accepts whatever the agent answers after checking; pays nothing today.

- document `bl_id` 9793c975-c98d-435c-8c79-5ae475a1b478 (Negotiable, approved, set 1, consignee "TO ORDER"); booking `dae59fbe-d1b3-4c1b-92ef-b291e173f105` (AHLU26SHA274613, AHL Contract Booking, `contract_id` 767c599a-30ea-4fbb-b1a3-dffd0305d290); request `5bd876eb-aa6b-4e7b-9fd9-53ee48bf8e9f` (telex_release, awaiting_customer_action, 2026-09-12 15:20 HKT).

### 4. Parameters

| Parameter | Formula (visible source) | Inputs | Value |
|---|---|---|---|
| issue `originals_count` | type's per-set number unless a zero condition applies: status at issue must be Approved (approved_status_at_issue), booking loaded/departed/closed (issue_shipment_status); prepaid hold never alters the number (issued_originals_count cl.4) | Negotiable 3 per set (document_form_by_type); approved; departed | 3 |
| issue `issuance_fee_usd` | type's issuance fee per set (issuance_on_shipped_cargo tier table) | Negotiable 75.00 | 75.00 |
| surrender `bl_set_sequence` | set of the surrendered originals | set 1 (first set issued) | 1 |
| surrender `originals_count` | history balance put into circulation − surrendered − void (surrender_count_from_history), non-zero only if the type offers telex release and cargo counts as shipped (surrendered_originals_count, surrender_shipment_status) | after the issue: 3 − 0 − 0; Negotiable offers; departed | 3 |
| telex fee `amount_usd` | type's fee unless the booking's own contract, active, held by the documentation party, has tier rank ≥ type threshold (contract_exemption_from_telex_fee; service_contract_tier_ranks); nil if release not effected (telex_fee_amount; telex_release_effected_state) | Key Account rank 4 < Negotiable threshold 5 → not relieved; effected after surrender | 55.00 |

Documentation charges due after the call: 75.00 + 55.00 = 130.00 (observed on replay; not a tool argument). No payment recorded; no waiver requested.

Answer to the fee challenge: the booking's own contract is AHL Key Account Contract (rank 4); a Negotiable bill needs rank 5; so the fee applies. The retired exemption wording in telex_release_at_origin ("documentation party itself held an active service contract") is flagged "no longer in force"; in this world it would test the same single contract and reach the same result.

### 5. Executable tool sequence

1. agent `find_customers(phone_number)` → `verify_customer_identity(customer_id, phone_number, customer_code)`.
2. agent lookups: `find_bills_of_lading(bl_number)`, `find_bol_service_requests`, `find_bol_ledger`, `find_bookings`, `find_service_contracts`.
3. agent asks about the originals → "never received any originals"; clerk at the Shanghai counter.
4. agent unlock + call `issue_document_with_originals_c9d717be(bl_id, booking_id, 3, 75.00)` → issued as set 1, 3 outstanding.
5. agent `unlock_user_discoverable_tool("surrender_full_set_at_origin_68a55055")`, gives bl_id / request_id 5bd876eb… / 1 / 3 → user `call_user_discoverable_tool` → "3 original(s) of set 1 surrendered at the origin office; originals outstanding now 0; status surrendered".
6. agent unlock + call `charge_telex_release_fee_be5da3ed(bl_id, booking_id, request_id, 55.00)` → request completed.
- dependencies: 5 needs 4; 6 needs 5. Terminal state (replay): status surrendered, 0 outstanding, issued_date 2026-09-14, charges due 130.00, request completed. Destination release is then governed by the destination-release rules (telex_release_at_origin cl.5); the KB offers no desk tool for it and the customer asks for nothing more.
- Observation O1-1 (tool-side): on a fresh seed, `surrender_full_set_at_origin_68a55055` with `originals_count` 0 on the still-approved record was accepted and set the status to surrendered, although both the KB and the runtime schema give the format "Whole number of 1 or more". The visible KB still excludes that path (see counter-proof); recorded for the policy side only.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials

Root: the customer asks for the telex release on the registered request.

| Problem | Owner | Tool |
|---|---|---|
| P1 issue the approved document, putting its originals into circulation (and booking the issuance fee) | agent | issue_document_with_originals_c9d717be |
| P2 surrender the full set at the origin office | user (printed shipper) | surrender_full_set_at_origin_68a55055 |
| P3 charge the telex release fee, closing the request | agent | charge_telex_release_fee_be5da3ed |

- **H1 P3 ← P2.** telex_release_at_origin cl.4 "takes effect when the full set of originals has been handed in at the origin office", cl.7 "The telex release fee can be entered only against a document whose status is surrendered"; telex_release_effected_state items 1–4; telex_fee_amount "When the release is not effected … nothing is booked"; record status approved → P3 cannot be done now; full_set_surrender_at_origin is the act that makes the status surrendered. **Derived** (combination of blocked-side principle, the surrender page's effect and the record).
- **H2 P2 ← P1.** telex_release cl.4 needs a full set handed in; full_set_surrender tool format "Whole number of 1 or more"; surrender_count_from_history "An original can be surrendered only if it is in circulation … Originals come into circulation through the issue of a document; a record that has never been issued has put none into circulation, so its history yields nothing to surrender" and its Q "Can originals be surrendered on a record that shows the status approved? No originals are in circulation on it: the history records none put into circulation, so the count is zero."; records: status approved, ledger empty, simulator "never received any originals" → something must put originals into circulation, and only an issue does. The dependency "no surrender on an unissued record" is **read off** (the sentence joins the issue side's rule and the surrender count in one statement, and the Q&A poses exactly this record state); "therefore issue now" is derived from issuance_on_shipped_cargo (conditions met) and document_issue_and_originals (issue puts originals into circulation).
- **H0 P1 permissible and owed now** (the customer never asks for an issue): issuance_on_shipped_cargo cl.1–3 with booking departed, 0.00 due, service standard long passed → **derived**.

Order: P1 → P2 → P3.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - telex fee 0.00 by contract relief → contract_exemption_from_telex_fee rank test with service_contract_tier_ranks (Key Account = 4) against Negotiable threshold 5 (telex_release_terms_by_type); only the booking's own contract counts and it is the only one;
  - telex fee 0.00 by the retired wording → telex_release_at_origin "That exemption test is no longer in force … the retired test must not be applied" (and it would give the same result here);
  - issuing with 0 originals → approved status and departed booking leave no zero condition; issued_originals_count cl.4 (prepaid hold never alters the number);
  - issuance fee skipped or waived → issuance_on_shipped_cargo cl.4 "charged once for the set being issued"; no waiver requested;
  - surrendering 0 originals on the approved record (executable, see O1-1) → excluded by the tool's documented format "1 or more", surrender_count_from_history and telex cl.4 (nothing was handed in, so no release took effect);
  - refusing / waiting because "there are no originals" → excluded: the issue is available now (all issue conditions met on record) and is a desk action;
  - recording the freight payment `KBL-FRT-24418` against the document → documentation_fee_remittances cl.4 "Money remitted against the booking does not discharge any documentation fee"; the customer pays nothing today;
  - prepaid hold on the issue → booking shows 0.00 due.
- "Do only what the customer asked" (charge/close the telex release): excluded by telex cl.7 + effected-state definition with status approved; a bare surrender is excluded by the count/format rules → the governed result (an effected release) cannot exist without P1 and P2. Excludable by reasoning; the P2 ← P1 hop is additionally stated in surrender_count_from_history (marked read off above).
